title: Launch Game Configuration
exceedsAvailableCards: Cannot exceed the number of available cards ({{max}})
tracksPatternMismatch: This pattern defines {{rows}} checkpoint row(s) but the course has {{checkpoints}} checkpoint(s). Scoring may misalign - make sure the pattern matches this scenario.
languageHint: Selects in-game text translations and video subtitle track.
playTutorialVideo: Play Taghunter tutorial video on each team's first bip
playIntroVideo: Play scenario intro video on each team's first bip
firstBipVideosHint: Both videos play in order (tutorial first, then the scenario intro) before the team's timer starts. Returning teams (already started) skip the videos.
startVideosHint: The ticked videos (tutorial first, then the scenario intro) play on screen when the game starts; the clock starts once they end. A game that has already started does not replay them.
playTutorialVideoAtStart: Play the Taghunter tutorial video when the game starts
playIntroVideoAtStart: Play the scenario intro video when the game starts
victoryScoreDesc: Each image is worth points (with combos and penalties). Ranking is by total points collected.
victorySpeedDesc: The first team to collect all the images wins. Ranking is by the time of the last image collected.
playModeTeamDesc: Several chips correspond to one team. Multiple players share a team.
playModeSoloDesc: Each chip corresponds to one team. One chip per player.
tracksCluesPageHint: On the second bip after a team returns, show the map with every checkpoint revealed (no per-checkpoint animation).
tracksCluesShowTitle: Show checkpoint titles on the clues page
tracksCluesShowText: Show checkpoint descriptions on the clues page
tracksCluesShowImage: Show checkpoint images on the clues page
tracksRoutesHint: Select one or more routes. With several routes, each team is assigned a route in order on the next step.
selfRegisterMultiRouteHint: Self-registration is unavailable with several routes: teams must exist before launch so each one can be given a route.
autoRegisterTeamHint: (teams form on first bip - no pre-built roster)
selfRegisterTeamHint: (each team types its own name on first bip)
addRandomNameOptionHint: (adds a "Choose my team name for me" button)
allowPlayerLanguageChoice: Allow player to choose their language
useNamePoolHint: (team gets a random name from the scenario's audience pool)
useRosterNamePoolHint: (pre-fill team names from the scenario's audience pool)
chipsAndTeamNamesIntro: Teams are registered automatically the first time they bip their chip. Selecting "Self registration" lets each team enter the name of its choice. The name list used for automatic assignment - or for a random pick when the team chooses one - is automatically matched to the scenario's age range.
reusePucesHint: (a finished chip can start a new game after a delay)
reuseDelayPucesMinutes: Delay before a finished chip can be reused (minutes)
reuseCardsHint: (a finished card can start a fresh run after a delay)
reuseDelayMinutes: Delay before a finished card can be reused (minutes)
autoResetPageHint: (returns the display to the ready screen after results - no Enter/reset needed)
enterToResetHint: (once results are on screen, pressing Enter or clicking resets the display like the refresh button)
showIdleLayoutHint: (shows the scenario title/subtitle on the between-teams screen; unchecked: background only)
idleSubtitleHint: Shown under the scenario title on the idle screen between teams (when the scenario's idle layout enables the subtitle). Leave blank to hide it.
showQuestPreviewHint: (on each punch, the quest images first appear faded - recommended for kids audiences)
showMissingStationsHint: (on an incomplete combination, shows the image of the missing station - untick if finding the right station is part of the game)
scoreWeighting: Weight scores by number of players
scoreWeightingHint: (earned points are multiplied by "largest team ÷ this team's size" so smaller teams compete fairly; the late malus is not weighted)
keepResultOnScreenHint: After each punch animation, the full image + score stay on screen for this long, then everything hides until the next punch.
malusPerMinuteHint: Game time is set by the Duration field above. The malus is subtracted from the final score for each minute over.
devicesToLaunchOnHint: Pick which paired devices should run this game. Online devices join within ~10s; offline devices receive the launch when they reconnect (within 15 minutes).
motherHostOnly: will host the game without participating
replaceConfigMessage: A configuration named “{{name}}” already exists for this scenario. Replace it?
importReplaceWarning: This replaces the current team list.
importNothingMatched: No usable rows were found in this file.
importReasonUnknownChip: Chip not found in this device’s roster
importReasonDuplicateChip: Chip already used by an earlier row
importReasonChipInUse: Chip is busy in another running game
importReasonIdNumberMismatch: Chip id and number point to different chips
importErrorMissingColumns: Couldn’t find the required columns. The file needs a header row with a “chip id” or “chip number” column, plus {{needs}}.
importNeedsTeam: a “name” column and a “team name” column
tagquestRegHint: Predetermined: you assign chips to teams on the next step. Self-register: players bip their chip to join a team on the registration screen at game start - just like Clash.
tagquestSoloSelfRegHint: Each player bips their own chip on the registration screen to enrol; one team is created per chip. Start the game once everyone has joined.
regAssignHint: Each selected device can register specific team(s): assigned devices show only their team(s) on the registration screen (a dedicated station). Teams are dealt automatically over every selected device; adjust the chips below to customize. A device with no team keeps the full team grid.
regAssignToggleDesc: Dedicated stations: each device only registers the teams assigned to it. When off, every device shows the full team grid.
regAssignAutoTitle: Assigned automatically - recomputed live as teams and devices change. Tap a team chip to pin this device manually.
clashRegHint: Self-register: players bind their chip to a clan on the registration screen at game start. Predetermined teams: you deal one contiguous block of chips per clan up front (starting at the first-chip index) - clans are formed the moment the game launches.
clashBulkNextStepHint: Chips per clan and the first-chip index are set on the next step.
clashBulkRemoveChip: Remove this chip from the clan
clashBulkFromImport_one: Allocation from the Excel import ({{count}} chip).
clashBulkFromImport_other: Allocation from the Excel import ({{count}} chips).
territoryBalisesHint: Pre-filled from the scenario. Enter the station numbers (e.g. 1, 2) as printed on the balises — not the internal station ids. Comma-separated, one row per territory.
clashNoTerritories: This scenario has no territories authored yet.
purgeNote: Each clan gets ONE purge: punching the purge station resets the leading clan's strongest territory to neutral.
purgeStationHint: Physical SI station players punch to spend their clan's purge (default 25).
purgeCollision: Station {{station}} is already used by territory "{{territory}}" - pick a different purge station (launch is blocked until resolved).
purgeUnavailable: This scenario has no purge image - The Purge is unavailable. Upload one in the studio's "The Purge" section to enable it.
